thread:
sophie: P1 from ACME Labs — their pipeline intermittently gets invalid JSON from our JSON mode. They've blocked ingestion. Customer sample: see below.

julian: Can you paste the example response + request ids?

sophie: Here's one (redacted):

Request:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "mode": "json",
  "model": "rwft-large-1",
  "prompt": "{...}",
  "request_id": "r-0a1b2c3"
}
```

Response (what the customer got):
```
{"items":[{"id":1,"value":{"name":"alpha"}}]}{"items":[{"id":2,"value":{"name":"beta"}}]}
```

sophie: The response above is two JSON objects concatenated (and sometimes tokens are interleaved causing invalid structure). They started seeing parse errors in our logs.

daniel: Looking at runtime logs — two requests r-0a1b2c3 and r-0a1b2c4 were served on the same worker w-42 within the same batch window.
Log snippet:
```
[2026-02-25T15:03:12Z] worker=w-42 request=r-0a1b2c3 cache=prefix_hit batch_slot=0
[2026-02-25T15:03:12Z] worker=w-42 request=r-0a1b2c4 cache=prefix_hit batch_slot=1
[2026-02-25T15:03:12Z] decoder=interleaved buffer_reuse=true
```

maria: That aligns with the batching + prefix caching change we shipped last week (commit abcdef1). It appears prefix cache reuse isn't isolating streaming output for JSON mode. Repro locally by firing concurrent JSON-mode requests with small prompts and enabled prefix cache — I see interleaved tokens.

maria: Quick repro script (run 50 concurrent requests):
```
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"mode":"json","prompt":"[...]"}' &
done
wait
```
```
# Observe some responses with concatenated or garbled JSON
```

daniel: Immediate mitigation: for canary/runtime set env REDWOOD_DISABLE_JSON_PREFIX_CACHE=true which disables prefix cache for json-mode. I pushed a hotfix to canary (runtime@b3f7e2) and routed 10% traffic.

ops-bot: deploy runtime@b3f7e2 to canary started — 2026-02-25T15:40:21Z

daniel: After 30m on canary, invalid_json errors down from ~12/min to 0/min. Suspect race where cached prefix buffer was reused across batch slots when output buffer reuse flag true.

julian: Customer on Dedicated cluster. I applied the env toggle for their cluster and they report failures dropped to near zero. They still want an RCA & permanent fix before we mark resolved.

maria: Plan: 1) revert risky buffer-reuse optimization in batcher for structured/json mode 2) add unit+fuzz tests for interleaved decode 3) add metric 'json_mode_invalid_parses' and alert 4) backport to Dedicated images.

daniel: Filed INFR-9842, assigned to @daniel and @maria. ETA for full fix & backport: 48 hours for hosteds, 72-96 for Dedicated images.

sophie: Assigning on-call + keeping ACME updated. Creating incident page and customer-facing timeline. I'll post updates here.

acme-eng: Thanks — we've paused ingestion and will resume once you confirm the fix. :pray:

sophie: Will keep you posted. Next update in 2 hours or earlier if we push a full rollback.
